A mechanical axis deviation exceeding what value was associated with discrepancies >0.5 cm between the two imaging techniques?
A. 2 cm
B. 1.5 cm
C. 2.5 cm
D. 3 cm
The correct answer is \boxed{A}. Mechanical Axis Deviation (MAD) Mechanical axis deviation (MAD) refers to the angular or linear displacement of the anatomical alignment of the lower limb.

What is the median percentage increase in cumulative trial duration for a series of 10 conventional trials compared to a single platform trial?
A. 171.1%
B. 282.0%
C. 311.9%
D. 349.1%
The correct answer is C (311.9%). Platform Trials Conventional Trials: Sequential trials where each treatment is tested individually.

Processed vegetarian foods often contain which substance that may worsen acne due to hormonal disruption?
A. Soy protein isolates
B. Soluble fiber
C. Preservatives
D. Unhealthy trans fats
The correct answer is A. Acne and Hormonal Factors Acne occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells.

In cases of athlete’s foot with pustular blisters indicating a secondary infection, which treatment is most appropriate?
A. Topical antifungals
B. Oral steroids
C. Antiviral medication
D. Systemic antibiotics
The correct answer is \boxed{D}. Athlete’s Foot (Tinea Pedis): A common fungal infection caused by dermatophytes.

What transcription factor is typically absent in embryonic hematopoietic progenitor cells derived from hESCs compared to adult HSPCs?
A. EZH1
B. BMI1
C. HOXA9
D. ASH1L
The correct answer is C. HOXA9. Hematopoietic Stem/Progenitor Cells (HSPCs) Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) generate all blood cells.

Eyelid surgery for dry eye may lead to worsening symptoms primarily due to which postoperative issue?
A. Scarring
B. Infection
C. Bleeding
D. Inflammation
The correct answer is \boxed{A}. Dry Eye Syndrome (DES) Dry eye syndrome occurs when the eyes do not produce enough tears or the tears evaporate too quickly.

Which dietary pattern emphasizes whole foods, vegetables, and healthy fats to support adrenal health?
A. Mediterranean diet
B. Low-carbohydrate diet
C. Paleo diet
D. Ketogenic diet
The correct answer is \boxed{A}. Adrenal Health Basics The adrenal glands produce hormones like cortisol, which regulate stress, blood pressure, and metabolism.

*What is the maximum recommended daily caffeine intake during pregnancy to minimize miscarriage risk?*
A. 100 mg
B. 200 mg
C. 300 mg
D. 400 mg
The correct answer is \boxed{B} (200 mg).

What is the first-line treatment for mild dehydration in children?
A. Intravenous fluids
B. Oral rehydration solution
C. Bed rest with cooling blankets
D. No intervention required
The correct answer is B. Sinusitis.

What minimum velocity (in m/s) is typically required for a bullet to cause a transverse fracture in a human femur?
A. 150
B. 300
C. 450
D. 600
The correct answer is 450 m/s (Option C).. Bone Fracture Mechanics Bones fracture when the energy delivered by an external force exceeds their structural strength.

A virus that becomes more contagious over time typically exhibits which pattern?
A. Increased lethality
B. Unchanged transmissibility
C. Higher mortality rate
D. Reduced deadliness
The correct answer is \boxed{D}. Transmissibility (Contagiousness) Definition: The ability of a virus to spread from one host to another.

After a vasectomy, what happens to the appearance of semen during ejaculation?
A. Decreases in volume
B. Remains unchanged
C. Becomes cloudy
D. Thickens significantly
The correct answer is \boxed{B}. Anatomy of the Male Reproductive System Vas deferens: A muscular tube that transports sperm from the testes to the urethra.
